notes: Direct fetch worked with no WAF (Rule 2 step 1). manufactum.com is the EN/international storefront of the German curated-goods retailer (de.manufactum.com is the German-language mirror; same catalogue). Manufactum is a wide general-merchandise retailer (clothing, luggage, office supplies, groceries, garden tools, household hardware) - only 4 genuine decor branches were found and extracted: Home & Living > Lighting, Home & Living > Home Accessories, Garden > Garden Decor (partial), and Kitchen > Crockery & Table Accessories (partial). Every other top-level department (Men, Women, Children, Household, Office Supplies, Sports & Toys, Luggage & Leather Goods, Body Care, Groceries) and every Furniture/Home Textiles/Bath-fixture/Kitchen-appliance node was inspected and excluded as functional/non-decor per the brief's EXCLUDE list. COUNT METHOD: every Manufactum category page embeds a site-authoritative 'productCount' field directly in its breadcrumb JSON (e.g. '"productCount":"(58)"'), which was cross-validated against manual product-tile counts (data-test-sell-product-tile) on several categories and found to match exactly - this was used as the primary Rule 1 evidence source, with full product-title inspection for any category suspected of being a mixed roll-up. MIXED ROLL-UPS FILTERED (drop, don't pad, per brief): (1) 'Candles' (site total 94 across 2 pages) contained 23 scented/fragrance-oil items alongside genuine unscented candles - filtered to 71 by reading every product title and excluding any containing scent/fragrance/diffuser/incense. (2) 'Glassware & Drinkware' (69) contained 2 'Purifier Water Filter Pitcher' items (functional water-filter appliance) - filtered to 67. (3) 'Serveware' (120 across 2 pages) contained 15 functional kitchen tools/appliances (coffee makers, frying pans, kitchen tongs, cooking spoons, salad servers, bar filter jugs) mixed in with genuine trays/bowls/jugs/carafes/teapots/dishes - filtered to 105. FACET RE-CUTS DROPPED (Rule 0.6 - pure subset of an already-counted sibling, verified by comparing product-ID sets, not names): 'Cosmetic Mirrors' (9/9 products already inside 'Mirrors' 14), 'Alarm clock' (7/7 already inside 'Clocks' 15), 'Garden Torches' (18/22 already inside Garden Decor's 'Outdoor Lighting' 68, remaining 4 are consumable refill-wax/wick/coloring-template SKUs, not distinct decor products) - all three dropped to avoid double-counting. RULE 0.6 TYPE-TREE vs ROOM/CONTEXT-TREE OVERLAP KEPT (both emitted, not deduped, since neither is an exact duplicate or pure facet-recut): 'Lighting > Outdoor Lighting' (58 items, breadcrumb Home>Home & Living>Lighting) and 'Garden > Garden Decor > Outdoor Lighting' (68 items, breadcrumb Home>Garden>Garden Decor, a different category ID/URL that is a superset also including concrete fire bowls/cones/cubes) are two distinct navigational entries with different product sets (58 of 58 items in the Lighting version are a subset of the 68 in the Garden Decor version, but the Garden Decor version adds ~10 fire-feature items) - both kept per Rule 0.6, overlap documented here. MINOR CROSS-LISTING NOT DEDUPED (too small to restructure, each category's own site-reported/filtered count used as-is): 3 of ~26-29 items shared between 'Wall Art, Prints & Globes' and 'Picture Frames' (a magnetic picture-rail product appears in both); some 'Bowl'/'Vase' SKUs appear in both 'Vases & Bowls' and 'Serveware'. KITCHEN & DINING SIBLING-FACET SIMPLIFICATION: the site's 'Crockery & Table Accessories' sidebar lists 9 flat sibling filters (Glassware & Drinkware, Porcelain service, Plates, Cups, Mugs, Cutlery, Serveware, Trays, Butter dishes, Jugs & Carafes, Serving cutlery, Coasters) that heavily overlap by product ID (Butter dishes 7/7, Jugs & Carafes 35/36, and Trays 24/27 are near-total subsets of 'Serveware'; Plates 8/9 is a near-total subset of 'Porcelain service'; Cups and Mugs are ~55-90% subsets of 'Porcelain service' with the remainder mostly already inside 'Glassware & Drinkware'). To avoid padding with 6 more overlapping rows, only the 3 broadest umbrella nodes were kept as leaves - Glassware & Drinkware, Porcelain service (labelled 'Dinnerware' below), and Serveware - each using its own site count (filtered where contaminated, see above). Cutlery and Serving cutlery were excluded entirely per the brief's kitchen-cutlery exclusion. EXCLUDED AS FUNCTIONAL/NON-DECOR (checked, not padded in): Bath > 'Bathtubs & Washbasins', 'Shower accessories', 'Soap Dishes & Dispensers' (fixtures/plumbing); Bath > 'Other Bathroom Accessories' (118 items - inspected product-by-product across both pages: laundry baskets/sorters, step stools, trash cans, toilet brushes/sets, bathroom scales, towel rails, toilet-paper holders, medicine cabinets - overwhelmingly functional bathroom storage/fixtures/hardware with no clearly decorative accent items, so dropped wholesale rather than padding with a few ambiguous utility hooks). Home Accessories > 'Decoration' (c202629, breadcrumb count 448 - EXCEEDS its own parent 'Home Accessories' node's 397, meaning it is a cross-category marketing tag/collection rather than a true taxonomy subset, so excluded). Home Accessories > 'Newspaper Holders' (storage), 'Stereophony', 'Telephones' (electronics), 'Scented candles' (Home Fragrance). Home & Living > 'Home Textiles' (Tablecloths/Tea Towels/Bedding/Curtains/Carpets/Blankets - all textiles, no separate curtain-rod-hardware node exists). Garden > 'Garden Fences', 'Garden Showers', 'Seat covers', 'Sunshades', 'BBQs & Outdoor Heating', 'Nesting Boxes & Bird Feeders' plus all gardening-tool/plant-care/furniture nodes. Children > 'Home accessories' (c199084, 26 items - almost entirely felt/textile nursery items: blankets, cushions, mobiles, heat pads - not decorative-accessory type products, excluded). All 'Outdoor home office / Living and furnishing / Natural living / Enjoy late summer / Multifunctional furniture / For a good time at home / Themes of X' links appearing on every category sidebar are site-wide seasonal marketing collection tiles (NEVER EXTRACT), confirmed by their identical repetition across unrelated category pages.
